about: Engine foundations 3, the proof: a brand-new perk and a relic written in data only (no TypeScript), loaded with addItems() by test/item-ops.test.ts and played in a fight. Test only: not game content.

perks.name: Blood for Blood (test)
perks.text: Once a fight, when an enemy drops an ally, bank {=effects.0.value} AP for your next turn, and your next hit deals +{=effects.1.value_pct}% damage.

effects.say: {self} swears it on {target}'s blood (Blood for Blood).

relics.name: Ember Charm (test)
relics.text: Once a turn your melee hit sets an enemy Burning. At the start of each of your turns you heal {=effects.1.amount.base} HP. Your reload costs {=effects.2.value|abs} AP less, never below {=effects.2.min}.
